title: Crash when removing children from GraphEdit in tool
body:
### Tested versions

- 4.3 stable

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable.mono - Windows 10.0.22631 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 Threads)

### Issue description

The editor crashes when removing children from a GraphEdit in a popup window in the editor (tool script). It leaves behind this backtrace:

### Steps to reproduce

To reproduce this in the MRP, open the project in the editor, and click "X" to close the popup window. This will crash the editor.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/SlashScreen/gd-graphedit-crash
